lines.text: The LORD commanded the forefathers to keep the Sabbath, but they stiffened their necks and would not receive His blessing.
If the people keep the Sabbath holy, kings and princes will sit on the throne of Saul, riding chariots and horses.

problems.problem: Its true detail "David's" isn't in Jeremiah 17:25 word for word.
The line still identifies ‘they’ as the forefathers, although verse 23 does not do so explicitly.
